description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Sun Visors for the Left and Right Passenger Compartment
Color: Gray
Passenger Side Visor has Built-In Mirror
Made by Suzuki
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Left, Sun Visor
Qty 1 – Right, Sun Visor
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
